protocol.name: fldesktop_window_v1

description.summary: window requests of fldesktop's own toolkits

protocol.description: Lets a client start moving one of its toplevels from a press on its own widgets (an empty part of a toolbar, menu bar or tab strip), as xdg_toplevel.move does, for toolkits that don't expose their xdg_toplevel object (FLTK).

request.name: move
request.description: Starts moving the toplevel whose surface this is, as long as a pointer button is held. Ignored for surfaces that are not mapped toplevels, and when no button is pressed.
